title: HarperCollins India to publish Sonia Gandhi’s memoir ‘Belonging,’ after Penguin row
summary: One of the most anticipated political memoirs of our time, Belonging is a dramatic and deeply personal story of love, identity, duty and belonging, and offers a rare insider's view of India’s journey, HarperCollins India said in a post on social media on 4 September.
